dataAgentConfiguration.name: UK Legal Firm Customer 360 Agent - Step 6 Routing Optimized
dataAgentConfiguration.description: Multi-source Fabric data agent configuration with explicit routing signals for client, case, finance, and engagement questions.

dataSources.name: ClientCasePortfolio
dataSources.description: Use for customer and legal case portfolio questions. Includes customer profile, case types, case values, case status, and solicitor assignment.

exampleQueries.question: How many active customers do we have?
How many open cases do we have by case type?
Which solicitor handles the most cases?

dataSources.name: FinancialTransactions
dataSources.description: Use for billing, invoice, payment, expense, and hours-worked questions.

exampleQueries.question: How many unpaid invoices do we have?

dataSources.name: ClientEngagement
dataSources.description: Use for customer interaction channel and activity questions based on engagement summary metrics.

exampleQueries.question: Which customers are in low engagement segment?
What is average interaction duration for corporate customers?
Which clients had no recent interaction?

dataSources.name: CaseFinanceInsights
dataSources.description: Use for cross-domain questions requiring both case context and financial outcomes from a pre-joined case-finance mart.

exampleQueries.question: Which high-value open cases have overdue invoices?
Open case value versus paid amount by solicitor

dataSources.name: SolicitorPerformance
dataSources.description: Use for solicitor productivity and performance questions using pre-aggregated metrics.

exampleQueries.question: Which solicitor has the highest total case value?
exampleQueries.explanation: Performance ranking by case portfolio value

exampleQueries.question: Which solicitors are in top performance tier?

dataAgentConfiguration.agentInstructions:
# Routing Topics

- When asked about customer profiles, case portfolio, solicitor assignment, or case status, use ClientCasePortfolio.
- When asked about invoices, payments, billing, hours, rates, expenses, or outstanding balances, use FinancialTransactions.
- When asked about meetings, calls, emails, interaction frequency, or interaction duration, use ClientEngagement.
- When asked a question that combines case context with financial outcomes, use CaseFinanceInsights.
- When asked about solicitor productivity, ranking, utilization, or performance tiers, use SolicitorPerformance.

# Routing Quality Rules

- Prefer one source when the topic is clear.
- Use cross-domain source only when the question explicitly combines case and finance intent.
- If routing confidence is low, inspect schema and examples before final source selection.
- Keep answers consistent by using the same source for semantically equivalent questions.
